desc:
Make a delicious chocolate cookie dessert without the fuss

QUICK AND EASY: Make a mug cookie by adding water or milk and popping in the microwave

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare mug cookie mix as is or explore the many Betty Crocker creative recipes

MICROWAVE CAKE: Enjoy an individual serving of chocolate fudge goodness without turning on the oven; Indulge in a mug cookie for sweet snacks and desserts

CONTAINS: 4 Servings
features:
Features

Soft-Baked Texture: Specially formulated to create chewy, bakery-style cookies with a soft center and no crunchy edges.
Easy to Prepare: Just add a few simple ingredients like butter, water, and eggs. Mix, roll, and bake.
Quick Baking Time: Fresh cookies in under 20 minutes — perfect for last-minute cravings or spontaneous baking.
Reliable Results: Consistent texture and flavor every time, whether you're a beginner or experienced baker.
Customizable Recipe: Acts as a great base for adding chocolate chunks, nuts, dried fruit, or other mix-ins.
From a Trusted Brand: Betty Crocker is a well-known name in baking, known for quality and ease of use.
 

Benefits

Delivers Bakery-Quality at Home: Soft, warm, homemade cookies without needing professional baking skills.
Convenient for Busy Lives: Ideal for quick treats after school, unexpected guests, or simple dessert needs.
Kid-Approved Flavor: Classic chocolate chip taste that appeals to kids and adults alike.
Great for Any Occasion: Perfect for parties, bake sales, lunchboxes, or just enjoying with a glass of milk.
Fun Family Activity: Easy enough for kids to help out in the kitchen and enjoy the baking experience.
No Guesswork: With pre-measured ingredients, you get consistent flavor and texture with every batch.

prep:
1. Heat oven to 350°F. Spray bottom and sides of 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray.
  2. Make sugar cookie dough as directed on pouch for drop cookies. Stir in ¼ cup of the candy sprinkles. Press dough evenly in bottom of pan.
  3. Make double chocolate chunk cookie dough as directed on pouch. Drop dough by spoonfuls over sugar cookie dough. Using metal spatula, evenly spread dough to cover sugar cookie dough layer. Sprinkle remaining 2 tablespoons candy sprinkles over top.
  4. Bake 30 to 34 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean and edges are set. Cool completely on cooling rack, about 2 hours.
  5. In small microwaveable bowl, microwave chocolate chips uncovered on High 30 to 60 seconds, stirring halfway through, until chips can be stirred smooth. Spoon into resealable food-storage plastic bag; partially seal bag. Cut small tip from corner of bag. Squeeze bag to pipe over top of bar.
  6. Let stand about 2 hours or until chocolate is set. Cut into 6 rows by 4 rows.
